arabic text: KARBALA SE JHO KABHI HO KE HAWA ATI HAI
english translation text: WHEN THE WIND OCCASIONALLY ARRIVES FROM KARBALA

arabic text: KISI MASOOM KI JO RONAY KI SADA\nATI HAI
english translation text: IT BRINGS WITH IT AN INFALLIBLE'S CRIES

arabic text: KAUN SOTA HAI KINARAY TERAY NEHR-E-FURAT?
english translation text: WHO RESTS ETERNALLY BY YOUR RIVERBANK, EUPHRATES?

arabic text: TERI MITTI SE ABHI TAK, KYUN BOO-E-WAFA ATI HAI?
english translation text: WHY DOES ITS LAND BEAR THE FRAGRANCE OF DEVOTION?

arabic text: MAA SAMAJHTI HAY DULHAN LAOON GI AAYA HAY SHABAB
english translation text: A MOTHER HAD HOPED TO WELCOME A BRIDE, SHE RECEIVED A YOUTH IN HIS PRIME

arabic text: SHEH SAMJHTAY HAIN KE AKBAR KI QAZA AATI HAY
english translation text: KING (HUSSAIN AS) KNOWS THAT AKBAR'S MARTYRDOM IS NEAR

arabic text: KOYI BEEMAR NA PARRHTA HO TAHAJJUD KI NAMAZ
english translation text: IS THERE SOMEBODY SICK PRAYING THE VOLUNTARY NIGHT NAMAZ (TAHAJJUD)?

arabic text: RAAT KO BAIRRYON KI KYUN YE SADA AATI HAY
english translation text: WHY DO I HEAR THE SOUNDS OF HANDCUFFS, LEG CUFFS AND CHAINS IN THE MIDDLE OF THE NIGHT?

arabic text: HAAN DHARAKTA NA HO MARQAD MAIN KAHEEN QALB E RUBAB
english translation text: I HOPE RUBAB'S (SA) HEART DOESN'T TREMBLE IN HER TOMB

arabic text: ALI ASGHAR, ALI ASGHAR KI SADA AATI HAY
english translation text: I HEAR SOMEONE CRYING 'ALI ASGHAR, ALI ASGHAR'
